photos.observation: Label: ZENG WHCD JGB37-520, DC 12V/22RPM, date 2026-10-16. No running/stall test.
Blade fuse seated in inline holder; marking appears to be 2, consistent with planned 2A. Voltage, manufacturer, curve and holder lead rating not established.
Screw-terminal MOSFET-style module consistent with prior photographed module; exact semiconductor marking not read reliably.
Barrel-to-screw connector with moulded minus left and plus right in this view. Mating dimensions, current rating and actual contact mapping not measured.
One red two-lead indicator LED, not the intended motor flyback rectifier. Exact size/electrical rating not supplied.
Factory-enclosed appearance; label MODEL 1250, INPUT AC100-240V 50/60Hz, OUTPUT 12V DC 5A; symbol centre-positive. Label-implied 60W, not a load test or independent certification.

Black axial rectifier-style diode, pale cathode band on upper-right end in supplied orientation. Body marking appears consistent with prior SR5100 stock but complete code/manufacturer not reliably legible. No electrical test result supplied.

Grey-handled multifunction stripper/pliers; serrated tip, stripping recesses, cutter area, M3/M3.5/M4/M4.5/M5 holes, latch and lower shaped openings visible. Exact brand/model, die compatibility and live-work insulation certification not identified.
Two bare motor electrical terminals on plastic rear end cap; no reliable plus/minus marking visible from this angle. No leads or diode attached.

Red and black leads installed at DC connector, consistent with marked positive and negative positions. Blade fuse pictured separately on bench; numeric/DC ratings not newly established. No independent retention/current test.

Red and black supply leads occupy outer blue power-block entries; middle LOAD and green control block empty. Consistent with previous intended mapping; labels/inside clamp are not fully visible. No multi-conductor rating or circuit acceptance inferred.
